CREATE TABLE `calls` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `shop_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `call_id` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `transcript` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `payload` json NOT NULL,
  `extraction` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `received_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `call_id` (`call_id`),
  KEY `calls_shop_fk` (`shop_id`),
  KEY `calls_received` (`received_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `calls_shop_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`shop_id`) REFERENCES `shops` (`shop_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=30 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
